description: List project messages, optionally filtered by conversation, client ID, channel, or message text. The query parameter searches message text, not message IDs. To edit, delete, or resend a known message_id, use manage_sent_message directly. Text matching runs only on the returned API page because the Public API has no full-text filter. Continue through pages while has_more is true before concluding that an older message is absent. Use this instead of find_conversations for text in historical messages.

channel.description: Channel name, type, or ID. Resolves to channelId.

client_id.description: Exact client ID to restrict messages. Use list_clients or lookup_client_profile first.

dialog_id.description: Conversation ID to restrict messages. From find_conversations or a conversation link.

limit.description: Messages per API page, 1 to 100. Default: 50.

only_active.description: Limit to active channels when channel is omitted. Default: false.

page.description: API page to inspect, starting at 1. Default: 1.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring in message text on this page only. Empty results do not mean no match exists on later pages.

response_format.description: Concise text by default, detailed text includes full message bodies. structuredContent always includes full text.

name: find_messages
title: Find messages
